families.name: goodui.line-chart
families.note: A two-series monthly-temperature specimen. Card is a linked GoodUI instance. Source rows, axis values, line labels, palette overrides, and optional icon-button data-table state are runtime configuration.

families.name: goodui.bar-chart
families.note: Grouped four-quarter specimen with two series in theme-aware marker blue and teal. The Card is a linked GoodUI instance; source rows and data-table state are runtime configuration.

families.name: goodui.chart-axis
families.note: The specimen shows X and Y labels together for reference. Each declarative Angular tag configures one axis and does not render alone.

families.name: goodui.chart-bar
families.note: One-bar-series reference. The declarative Angular tag configures a series inside BarChart and does not render alone.

families.name: goodui.chart-line
families.note: The specimen shows one line. The declarative Angular tag configures a series inside LineChart and does not render alone.
